facts.statement: Arjun Mehta is a Senior UI/UX Designer.
Arjun's practice includes user research, interviews, journey mapping, prototyping, and usability testing.

content.body: I'm Arjun Mehta, a UI/UX and Product Designer based in Bengaluru. I use research, iteration, accessible interaction design, and scalable systems to clarify the workflows people rely on.
content.headline: Making complex product experiences easier to use.

sections.purpose: Introduce Arjun's role, positioning, and primary portfolio action.

content.headline: Designing for moments where clarity matters.
content.intro: Across payments, commerce, logistics, and healthcare, I focus on understanding friction and shaping clearer paths through the product.

projects.contribution: Research, funnel analysis, flow redesign, prototyping, and usability testing.
projects.description: Android and iOS experiences addressing lengthy verification, unclear progress, and unnecessary interaction steps.
projects.title: Payments and onboarding

projects.contribution: Analytics, heatmaps, usability testing, hierarchy, validation, and progressive disclosure.
projects.description: A responsive checkout experience addressing unnecessary fields, weak error handling, delivery choices, and mobile interaction issues.
projects.title: E-commerce checkout

projects.contribution: Operations-user interviews, workflow mapping, tables, filtering, tracking, and reusable components.
projects.description: A desktop platform for shipments, drivers, routes, delivery exceptions, and performance management.
projects.title: Logistics operations

projects.contribution: Information architecture, search filters, availability indicators, booking flow, and accessibility patterns.

content.headline: From friction to a system people can trust.

steps.text: Use interviews, analytics, journey mapping, and workflow analysis to identify where people hesitate or lose context.
steps.title: Understand

steps.text: Clarify information architecture, user flows, hierarchy, interaction patterns, and responsive behavior.
steps.title: Shape

steps.text: Prototype and test key paths so decisions respond to observed behavior rather than assumption.
steps.title: Test

steps.text: Document reusable patterns and support design-to-development handoff so improvements remain consistent.
steps.title: Scale

roles.summary: Lead end-to-end product design for consumer payment and merchant products, from research and flow definition through prototyping, testing, and system-supported delivery.

Designed web and mobile product experiences across SaaS, e-commerce, logistics, healthcare, and consumer technology, collaborating with product and engineering teams through implementation and design QA.

sections.purpose: Provide concise professional context and connect the portfolio narrative to real product work.

content.body: I work across research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, accessibility, prototyping, and design systems. The Nova Design System brought together tokens, components, variants, accessibility specifications, documentation, and a closer connection between Figma and production component architecture.
content.headline: Patterns that help good decisions travel further.
